subject: HealthSync compliance add-ons — pricing & concession options
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthsync.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSync Procurement <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and timeline

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to get a clear line-item breakdown for the compliance add-ons we discussed so we can circulate an initial estimate to finance. Specifically we need: audit-log retention tiers and per-GB pricing, managed KMS vs HSM pricing (one-time setup + recurring), and EU residency incremental costs.

We have a hard procurement window: PO submitted by 31 May if numbers look reasonable. Also, can you attach SOC 2 evidence and the event schema for audit logs so our security team can do a quick review?

Attached: HS_SOW_v1.pdf (stub) — draft SOW for our internal reference.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Engineering — HealthSync
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and timeline

Hi Daniel — appreciate the clear ask and the procurement timeline. Below is a concise breakdown (ballpark numbers so procurement can start modeling). I've attached a more detailed pricing spreadsheet as well.

Summary (monthly list prices):
- Audit logs retention:
  - 30 days (included) — no extra charge
  - 90 days — $1,200 / month flat (up to 5TB); $0.18 / GB overage
  - 365 days — $3,600 / month flat (up to 5TB); $0.12 / GB overage
- Managed KMS (multi-tenant): $0.015 / key / month + $0.0003 / encrypt call
- Dedicated HSM (per-seat w/ provisioning): $2,500 one-time onboarding + $1,250 / seat / month (includes key rotation ops)
- HIPAA compliance + attestation: $2,000 / month (includes controls, BAAs, and policy mapping)
- EU data residency (regional shard): incremental $4,000 / region / month for isolated storage + $0.02 / token routing surcharge

Concession guidance if they commit to a 12-month Dedicated capacity reservation (tiered):
- 12 mo commit >= $300k ARR => 18% discount on compliance add-ons
- 12 mo commit >= $500k ARR => 22% discount on compliance add-ons + waive HSM onboarding fee
- One-time onboarding credit: up to $15k for migrations when deal > $500k ARR

Deliverables we can provide immediately: SOC 2 summary (redacted), audit-log event schema, and a sample KMS integration guide. I uploaded the SOC 2 report link for procurement to review.

If you want, we can run a quick pricing model call tomorrow to align numbers before you take this to finance.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-sheet-20270514.xlsx (detailed line items)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthsync.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSync Procurement <procurement@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and timeline

Markus — thanks for the breakdown, that helps. A few clarifying questions from finance/security:

1) For the 365-day retention option, can you share estimated storage/egress cost assumptions per TB so we can compare to our internal TCO model?
2) HealthSync is pushing for HIPAA to be bundled into the platform license if we do a sizable commitment; would Redwood consider including HIPAA at no recurring cost for the first 12 months if we do the $500k ARR commitment?
3) Our security team will need the raw audit-log event schema and a short runbook for retention/archival. Can you confirm lead time to provide these?
4) Procurement asked whether the HSM onboarding fee is negotiable — a waiver would help us close.

Requested timeline: we need a clean commercial term sheet by 24 May to review with legal. Can you confirm you can make that date?

If you can do sample TCO numbers and confirm the HIPAA concession, we can move quickly.

Regards,
Daniel
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: internal: concession proposal for HealthSync (do we approve?)

Markus — quick internal on the HealthSync ask. My suggested play to keep the deal economics sound but competitive:

- Approve 22% discount on compliance add-ons for $500k ARR 12-mo commit (matches our existing tier).
- Waive HSM onboarding fee (one-time concession) for that tier.
- Include HIPAA bundle at $0 recurring for the first 12 months (then standard $2k/mo) — this is effectively a temporary feature add to help procurement sign.
- Offer 3 months of extended audit-log retention (move them to 365 for free for first 90 days) to prove ops and reduce their initial MOP.
- Require signed PO/DocuSign and 50% upfront to make the onboarding credit and waived fees apply.

Legal note: waiver of HSM onboarding and HIPAA free period will need a short MSA amendment; run with Legal to confirm language but this is standard.

If you want, I can draft an offer email with the exact numbers for you to send to Daniel.

— Marcus
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthsync.com>
Cc: HealthSync Procurement <procurement@healthsync.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: HealthSync compliance bundle pricing and concessions (subject to PO)

Hi Daniel — appreciate the patience while we validated internally. Based on your timeline, here's a firm commercial offer (valid until 28 May):

Commercial summary (monthly recurring unless noted):
- Audit logs: 365-day tier, $3,600 / month (up to 5TB) — WAIVED for first 90 days (we'll provide 3 months at no charge)
- Managed KMS: $0.015 / key / month + $0.0003 / encrypt call (standard)
- Dedicated HSM: onboarding fee WAIVED (one-time) + $1,250 / seat / month
- HIPAA bundle: included at no recurring cost for first 12 months (after 12 months revert to $2,000 / month unless a renewal/extension is agreed)
- EU data residency: $4,000 / region / month (optional)

Discounts & conditions:
- 22% discount applied to all compliance add-on recurring charges when HealthSync signs a 12-month Dedicated capacity commitment >= $500k ARR
- Onboarding credit: up to $15k available when > $500k ARR and 50% upfront payment received
- Offer valid until 28 May 2027; requires signed PO or DocuSign execution and initial payment per above to lock concessions

Deliverables we will share within 48 hours of acceptance: full SOC 2 report (redacted), audit-log event schema, KMS/HSM integration runbook, and an MSA amendment template for the waived onboarding fees. DocuSign link for the term sheet: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm you want us to prepare a redlined term sheet (we can do this same-day).
2) If agreed, sign the DocuSign or send a PO by 28 May to secure the concessions.

If you'd like a short call to walk legal/procurement through the MSA amendment language and the audit-log schema, Marcus and Irene are available early next week.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attachments referenced: pricing-sheet-20270514.xlsx
